Thanks Marcus — good call on keeping it small. A few venue notes after I checked with LumaRoom: 

- Kitchen closes at 9:00 PM sharp for events that night (per house manager). That means plated service can continue until 9:00 but we shouldn't rely on hot finishing beyond that.
- No open flames or table-top burners allowed (so no flambé or torch finishes).
- LumaRoom will permit one server in the event room; any additional staff must stay in the service corridor.
- Service door width is 36" and there is a small freight elevator (max 500 lbs) — larger service carts will need to be staged earlier.

Recommendation: move to plated petit desserts (bite-sized plates) + boxed coffee pour-station. If the vendor offers chilled pre-plated items, they can be staged in the kitchen before 8:45 and brought in for table service.

I've attached venue_layout_v2.pdf (shows service door and staging). I'll reach out to LumaRoom operations to reserve the 7:30–9:30 service window but expect a hard stop at 9:00 for kitchen.

Grace

Hi Bluprint team / Mike —

We're organizing a small post-workshop dessert reception for Harmonix Labs at LumaRoom (SOMA) on Tues evening. Quick specs below — please send a firm quote and menu options by EOD today if possible: 

- Headcount: 22 (final may vary +/- 2).
- Service window: 8:30–9:15 PM. Note: LumaRoom kitchen closes at 9:00 PM — see attached venue_layout_v2.pdf.
- Request: plated petit desserts (assorted) with at least two GF items and one vegan option. Please advise on nut-free accommodation (we have 1 confirmed nut allergy).
- Coffee/espresso bar: setup to be ready at 8:30 with one barista.
- Staffing: indicate minimum # of servers/front-of-house required for plated service and timing for setup (we prefer 7:30–8:15 load-in).
- Budget target: please include per-person pricing and any travel/setup fees.

Attachments: guest_list_final.csv (current attendee list). Drive link with event itinerary: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-harmonix-onboard-itinerary

Hi Marcus / Grace —

Thanks for the details — Bluprint can support plated petit desserts + espresso bar. Summary and attachments below: 

- Sample menu (attached): 6-item petit assortment (3 standard, 2 GF, 1 vegan). We can swap items per preference.
- Nut-allergy handling: we recommend individually boxed desserts for the guest with a severe nut allergy to eliminate cross-contact; alternatively, we can dedicate a nut-free prep station (adds $95).
- Pricing: $18/person for plated 3-piece petit selection + $6/person for barista station (includes barista, milk options, syrups). Minimum staff: 2 FOH servers + 1 barista. Setup fee: $60. Travel within SF: included. Total estimate for 22 guests: $528 (food) + $132 (barista) + $60 setup = $720.
- Timeline: arrival 7:45 PM for staging; plated service 8:30–8:55 PM; kitchen breakdown by 9:05 PM. Note: we can comply with a 9:00 kitchen close if desserts are pre-finished and plated in the kitchen before 9:00.

Attachments: quote_bluprint_20260929.pdf

Please confirm final headcount and whether you want boxed dessert for the allergic guest or nut-free prep. We need final numbers by Mon Oct 5 to guarantee staffing.
